title: Pages that connect — the screens, round 3

steps.headline: The line under the key box now says how the key is stored, not what the page can see.
steps.changed: "Your key is stored encrypted on this computer only. It isn't backed up or synced, and YouCoded sends it only to api.todoist.com." Close to your wording, with one correction: the key does go to the one service it belongs to, so "not accessible to outside services" would not be true.
steps.notice: Every part of the sentence is something the app actually does: it is encrypted with the computer's own keychain, never kept unencrypted, and never synced.

steps.path: Pages → Headlines, after an edit added a second feed
steps.headline: The new permission and what was already allowed now share one box.
steps.changed: The new line leads under a small "New" label; a hairline, then "Already allowed" with the older lines in smaller text.
steps.notice: One box answers "what could this page do" in full.

steps.path: The Task board card, opened from your phone
steps.headline: On the phone, the reason now sits inside the greyed button.
steps.changed: "Finish on your computer", and under it in smaller text, "Adding a key isn't supported on the phone yet. Open this page on your computer to set it up."
steps.notice: The one control where Allow would be carries its own explanation.
steps.risk: Long text in a greyed button is harder to read than the same text beside it.
